about: Welp-35B-A3B (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B in 13.2 GB) at the full 262k context with a q4_0 KV cache on an RTX A2000 8GB Laptop GPU (35 W): llama.cpp b11681, auto-fit (--fit-target 256) keeps attention, the KV cache and as many experts as fit on the GPU and maps the rest from the GGUF in host RAM; the CPU share runs on the 12 performance-core threads (--threads 12 --cpu-range 0-11 --cpu-strict 1), and --ubatch-size 512 raises prefill at no decode cost. --cache-ram 0 turns off the host prompt cache. Measured on a ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 (i7-12700H, 32 GB single-channel DDR5, display on the Intel GPU), 30 s decode runs: 30.5 tok/s with the rtx-5060-ti-16gb launch, 31.5 with fit 256, 33.1 with pinned threads, 33.7 with pinned threads on b11681. The weights are memory-mapped, so free RAM falls by only about 1.5 GB in the lab, but about 8 GB of experts stay in the page cache (8.7 GB drop when loaded without mmap); needs.host_ram_gb counts them.
